title: Support Complementarity
body_html:
Support Complementarity

Let $x \in X(A)$ and $y \in Y(A)$. If $i \in \operatorname{supp}(x)$, then the pure row $i$ obtains the value against $y$. If $j \in \operatorname{supp}(y)$, then the mixed strategy $x$ obtains the value against the pure column $j$.

References

  • [MFoGT, Proposition 2.4.1(b)] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, references/MechDesign.pdf. Complementarity on supports of optimal strategies.
